tool_args.command:
python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/profiling_output_v6_random_s025/profiling_results.json'))
ii=d['interaction_index']
print('=== Interaction Index ===')
for phase in ['high_sparsity','mid_sparsity','low_sparsity']:
    v=ii[phase]['0.25']
    print(f'{phase}: mean={v[\"mean\"]:.4f}, median={v[\"median\"]:.4f}, ci=[{v[\"ci_low\"]:.4f},{v[\"ci_high\"]:.4f}]')
print()
pp=d.get('per_problem_ii',[])
print(f'per_problem_ii count: {len(pp)}')
nh=sum(1 for p in pp if p.get('ii_high') is not None)
nm=sum(1 for p in pp if p.get('ii_mid') is not None)
nl=sum(1 for p in pp if p.get('ii_low') is not None)
print(f'n_high={nh}, n_mid={nm}, n_low={nl}')
print()
# gradient
vals_h=[p['ii_high'] for p in pp if p.get('ii_high') is not None]
vals_m=[p['ii_mid'] for p in pp if p.get('ii_mid') is not None]
vals_l=[p['ii_low'] for p in pp if p.get('ii_low') is not None]
import statistics
mh=statistics.median(vals_h); mm=statistics.median(vals_m); ml=statistics.median(vals_l)
grad=ml/mh if mh!=0 else None
print(f'median_high={mh:.4f}, median_mid={mm:.4f}, median_low={ml:.4f}')
print(f'gradient(low/high)={grad:.4f}')
print()
print('=== Pass/Fail ===')
print(json.dumps(d['pass_fail'],indent=2))
"
